title: Is Dallas Cowboys Owner Jerry Jones a 69 GOD?
htmlContent: Jerry Jones has been under scrutiny over the years as the owner of the Dallas Cowboys has been caught saying some iffy stuff on camera. In the wise words of West Coast Legend Kendrick Lamar, "Freaky-ass N****, he a 69 God." Just watch these shorts - Jerry Jones wants the glory: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N5w7zKC3MFs Good Morning Jerry Jones: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/woUHZdfur0I     Jerry Jones speaking with Cowboy Fan, Jamie Foxx: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/VkPV2InRR8o Jerry Jones speaks about hiring the new head coach for the cowboys, Brian Schottenheimer: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/AvVABu_az5o For many of you who don't know what a gloryhole is, "A gloryhole is a hole made in a thin wall or other type of partition where a man can insert their penis for sexual stimulation by an anonymous person on the other side." As ,the 2024-2025 NFL season is close to an end as fans will tune into Superbowl LIX to watch the second showdown between Philadelphia Eagles and the Kansas City Chiefs, many NFL fans around the world are curious to know, "Why are the cowboy fans so loyal to Jones especially when his mind seems to be not related to the game of football." As the Washington Commanders and Philadelphia Eagles show why they are the top teams in the NFL-East division, we all generally assume that the cowboys are going to be considered the 3rd best team in that division for the next few years... Ultimately we may all see Cowboy Fans "run for their lives" to support a new team in the beginning of the 2025-2026 season.   How many of you will be fans of the Dallas Gloryboys?
